_about: Pitch Direct: a tight direct-response talking-head pitch, studied from the hand-cut 'car detailers v2' reel (20 Oct user test). Boxed bold upper-case captions (#111 box, white ink, the spoken word in yellow) that the face-aware placer keeps off the face (no fixedY), one slam on the strongest claim in the first seconds, punch-ins on key words and numbers, graphics early when a number or a process is said. Hard cuts, no music by default, no pages or paintings. Not here yet (needs engine/planner work): v2's short yellow hook headline - the pitch title box draws white text and does not hide the captions, so above-the-head captions cover it.

director.style: A tight direct-response pitch. The first 2.5 s carry the single strongest claim (the guarantee, the result, the number); when the speaker says it later, open cold on that clause and keep the condition it depends on right after it. Cut every throwaway sentence ('no hassles', 'so if this is something you're interested in') and trim pauses hard. Punch in (1.08-1.12x) on each key word and number, back out on the next line: a picture change every 1.1-2.2 s.
director.restraint: Few, loud moments: one slam, at most two graphics. No word pages, no highlight pages, no bursts, no paintings, no B-roll; the speaker's face and the captions carry everything else.
director.slam: Once per video, landing inside the first ~2.5 s of the cut, on the strongest claim word as it is spoken (a verdict, a number, 'refund', 'free', 'guaranteed'). pre / post = the speaker's own words just before / after it (2-4 words each). 1.2-1.8 s.
director.graphics: When a graphic is offered: as early as the engine allows (the first from ~3 s of the cut), on a number or a process the speaker states (a price, a guarantee's steps), at most two, 2.5-3 s each.
director.captions: Automatic: boxed upper-case lines with the spoken word in yellow, kept clear of the face. Plan no keywords, icons, nametags or banner.
